doc.title: Benih prototype
proto: Prototype with sample data. No login, payment or data is actually processed.
brand.label: Benih, home
lang.label: Language
home.welcomeText: A place for environmentalists to contribute and support one another in protecting the environment and building a sustainable future. However small, your care for the environment always makes a difference.
home.tagline: Every small act of care makes a difference.
home.nearText: Find reforestation programmes and environmental actions nearby, then join in with other members.
feat1.d: Take part as a volunteer or paid helper in actions near you.
feat2.d: Support the activities you care about. 1 Benih = {price}.
feat3.d: Invite other members and collect Benih for your action.
feat4.d: Volunteer points and donations unlock new badges.
home.none: No programmes within this radius yet.
map.label: Map of activities
map.note: Illustration. In the real app this is Google Maps, and pins follow each activity’s coordinates.
share.title: Share
share.ig: For Instagram, copy the link and paste it into your story or bio. Example link: {url}
join.title: Join this activity
join.own: This is an activity you organise. Manage participants in the left-hand section.
join.loginPrompt: Log in to join this activity.
join.volDone: Your attendance is confirmed: +{n} volunteer points.
join.volWait: You’ll get {n} volunteer points once the organiser confirms your attendance.
join.asPaid: You’ve signed up as a paid helper · {status}
role.volDesc: No Benih in return. You earn volunteer points and badges.
role.paidDesc: Receive Benih in return. You’ll be taken to a chat with the organiser to agree on the amount.
manage.title: Participants
manage.help: Confirm volunteers’ attendance so they receive {n} volunteer points. For paid helpers, agree on the Benih amount by message, record the agreement, then pay after the activity.
th.name: Name
agree.label: Agreed Benih
support.title: Support with Benih
chat.agreedOwn: Pay from the activity page once the work is done.
chat.agreedOther: The organiser pays once the work is done.
chat.ownHint: Discuss the tasks and the Benih amount, then record the agreement on the activity page.
chat.otherHint: Discuss the tasks and how many Benih you’ll receive. The organiser records the agreement.
chat.draft: Hi, I’m interested in joining as a paid helper. What tasks do you need help with, and how many Benih would that be?
chat.autoReply: Thank you! We need help carrying seedlings from the nursery twice. How about {n} Benih? I’ve recorded it as our agreement.
chat.title: Messages with {name}
chat.empty: No messages yet. Start the conversation below.
chat.label: Message
chat.demoNote: In this prototype the organiser replies automatically and records an agreement of {n} Benih.
